content.value: An automobile weighing 1800 kg is driven down a 6° incline at a speed of90 km/hr when the 17 $6 ^ { \circ }$ brakes are applied, causing a constant total breaking force (applied by the road on the tires) of 6300 N. Determine (i) the distance travelled by the automobile as it comes to a stop, (ii) the time required for the automobile to come to a stop.

<sub>4(b)</sub> Two smooth disks A and B, having a mass of 1 kg and 2 kg, respectively, collide with the 18 velocities shown in figure. If $e = 0 . 7 5$ , determine velocity component of each disks after collision.

<sub>5(a)</sub> The <sub>propeller</sub> of a small airplane rotates at a constant rate of 1800 rpm in a clockwise sense when viewed by the pilot. Knowing that the airplane is turning left along a horizontal circular <sub>path</sub> ofradius 1200 m, and that the speed of the airplane is 270 km/hr, determine the angular acceleration of the propeller at the instant the airplane is moving on west.
